update.title: Built an Android app for daily sleep-tracking
update.summary: Built a local-first React Native app for daily ratings, notes, optional sleep times, reminders, and portable JSON storage.

preview.description: Daily Check-In mobile form beside its matching portable JSON record and local backup

blocks.body:
## Make daily tracking quick to enter

Daily Check-In brings sleep quality, alertness, mood, dreams, notes, and optional sleep times into a focused Android form. Large rating controls and date-based entries keep the routine direct without turning it into a long questionnaire.

## Keep the record local and readable

Each day is stored in one versioned JSON document selected through Android’s file picker. The file remains inspectable, copyable, and compatible with user-chosen synchronization, while a separate on-device backup provides recovery if document access fails.

blocks.description: Daily Check-In entry form writing through a storage layer to a user-selected JSON document and local recovery backup, with optional synchronization. One storage boundary writes the readable document and an independent recovery copy.

blocks.body:
## Give the document a stable shape

A version field and date-keyed entries keep the file understandable outside the app. Each entry carries only the recorded values for that day, making the document straightforward to inspect, copy, or consume elsewhere.

blocks.description: A versioned, human-readable document keeps the record portable and gives integrations a stable, narrow input.
